title: Downsampling probability schema
description: Schema for the CSV provided with params.downsample_p_at_1x. One row per HighPass sample included in the downsampling study (study 3). p_at_1x is the Picard DownsampleSam probability that yields ~1x coverage for that sample; DOWNSAMPLE_BAM scales it linearly per target fraction (P = fraction * p_at_1x). Values are taken verbatim from the original script's hardcoded per-sample table (03_qc/3_Downsampling/1_create_downsampled_bams.sh) — the depth measurement that originally produced them is not itself in the repo.

sample_id.errorMessage: Sample ID must be provided and cannot contain spaces.

p_at_1x.errorMessage: p_at_1x must be a number between 0 and 1.
